relations.zotero_refs: [Q8FCH7LF]: 296, n. 42. "Dpa' bo Gtsug lag phreng ba (1504-1566) relates that although Chu mig pa was a scholar at Snar thang, he had come to Rgya M/'ching ru ba [in the Gling stod college of Gsang phu ne'u thog] to debate with him. Unable to defeat him, he became his disciple."

comments: Fl. late 12th to early 13th c. Fourth abbot of gSang phu gling stod (ID:6172).
